| Look here! All these lively fleas flocked to our caravan. Thanks to you and your hunting, our numbers grow grand.
| [[Fleamaster Mooshka]]
| Hr = SS

<b>Fleas</b> are winged, furry bugs scattered throughout most of [[Pharloom]]. They can be found caged, stuck, or resting in precarious locations. 

== In-game Events ==
When near a Flea's location, they can make sounds such as snoring or whimpering, or they can be silent. Fleas communicate through high pitched barking and howls. When freed or awoken, Fleas let out a characteristic "awoo", and fly off screen, presumably to the [[Flea Caravan]].

There are 30 Fleas that can be found in total, which includes [[Kratt]], [[Vog]], and the [[Huge Flea]].

[[Vog]] provides the locations of missing Fleas for [[Rosaries]] once she has been found.

* After 5 Fleas are found, [[Fleamaster Mooshka]] moves the Caravan to [[Greymoor]], skipping the [[Moorwing]] fight if it hasn't already been defeated, and rewards Hornet with the [[Flea Brew]].
* After 12 Fleas are found, they move to [[Blasted Steps]] if the [[Last Judge]] has been defeated, and reward Hornet with a [[Spool Fragment]].
* After 22 Fleas are found, they move to the Pale Lake in [[Putrified Ducts]] if Hornet has visited that location, and reward Hornet with a [[Tool Pouch]].
* After all 30 Fleas are found, Hornet can receive the [[Egg of Flealia]] and gain access to [[Festival of the Flea]] in [[Act 3]].

== Locations ==
[[File:Map Pin Flea.png|right]]
Lost Fleas can be found all across Pharloom. They may be found in any order.
